summary: Source-reviewed rework recovered prose-supported alisporivir activity/toxicity rows, reconciled linked DBAASP/DRAMP rows with explicit database-only and endpoint-label cautions, and bounded mechanism claims to postentry timing plus cyclophilin-inhibitor context.
adjudication_summary: Worker-6 source-reviewed the repaired worker-2 and worker-4 layers against XML/PDF/OA/database packet surfaces and closed rwk-complete-test-0001 as accepted_with_cautions; no blocking or major rework target remains.

materials_exhausted.note: Primary XML/PDF/OA package and linked database rows were sufficient for the source-supported values; landed supplementary .bin files are HTML landing/help/PubMed captures and contain no source-supported supplementary tables.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP/DRAMP literature links match the selected paper. Activity values from the local paper support EC50, EC90, and CC50, while sequence/modification details and DRAMP mixed-reference text remain preserved as source_conflict/database-only cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: The paper has no structured tables; worker-2 recovered source-supported prose/Fig. 1 activity and toxicity rows with endpoint, value, unit, target, assay context, and source locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is bounded to cyclophilin-inhibitor context, no-entry effect at 5 µM, and postentry timing; exact molecular target is not overclaimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_material: Local supplementary captures are HTML/PubMed/help landing pages and supplementary_tables.json is empty; no local supplement changes activity/toxicity/mechanism conclusions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary source names alisporivir/Debio 025 and describes it as a cyclosporine analogue, but does not report the database sequence string or DRAMP modified-residue map; those details remain database-only provenance.
DBAASP labels the antiviral row as IC50 REP while the primary source reports EC50 0.46 ± 0.04 µM; value is retained with endpoint-label caution.
DRAMP activity text combines Ref.32376613 with Ref.32568027; this final review supports only the Ref.32376613 SARS-CoV-2 EC50/EC90 and CC50 values from the local paper.
The primary XML has table-count 0 and local supplementary captures are HTML landing/help/PubMed pages; no spreadsheet/PDF supplement table value is locally recoverable or required for acceptance.
Fig. 1 was reviewed through XML/PDF prose and caption; exact image-only curve datapoints beyond text-reported EC50/EC90/CC50/10 µM qualitative inhibition are not fabricated.
Source supports postentry life-cycle timing and cyclophilin-inhibitor context; it explicitly leaves the precise SARS-CoV-2 mechanism unresolved.
